mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a contractionary monetary policy combined with economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: contractionary monetary policy with economic slowdown
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the past month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% annualized, it signals accommodative monetary policy without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy without inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2%.
